headline: Revenue climbs, profit cools from last quarter
summary_short: Zimmer Biomet reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $2,177M, up 4.8% y/y and 4.3% q/q; net income of $198.3M rose 29.8% y/y but fell 16.7% q/q, and diluted EPS of $1.03 was up 33.8% y/y though down 15.6% q/q.
summary_long: Revenue was $2,177M, up 4.8% y/y and 4.3% q/q. Gross margin was about 70.8%, down roughly 158bp q/q and 67bp y/y. Operating margin was about 15.0%, down about 291bp q/q but up 54bp y/y. EBITDA was $598.8M, down 6.5% q/q, up 4.0% y/y. Net income was $198.3M (-16.7% q/q, +29.8% y/y); diluted EPS $1.03 (-15.6% q/q, +33.8% y/y). Cash fell to $410M (-3.3% q/q, -26.4% y/y).
